abbrev assumption_varying_bernoulli_probability_domain {T : ℕ}
    (B : BernoulliSatisfactionModel T) : Prop :=
  (∀ t, 0 < B.successProb t) ∧
    (∀ t, B.successProb t < 1) ∧
      (∀ i j : ItemType T, B.successProb i = B.successProb j)
